Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our exec team is aligned on the pilot but Finance pushed back on the early-termination and ramp clauses in the SOW. Specifically they want an explicit ability to downsize scope at 30/60/90 days without incurring the full committed spend, or at minimum a predictable downsell protection schedule that scales liability down over the first 90 days.

Can Redwood provide an exception for pilots where a capped downsell liability applies (e.g., 40% liability in month 1, 25% in month 2, 0% after month 3) and a simple opt-out path tied to objective milestones? Legal asked for language they can send to us for review. We need this to move to PO and signature this month.

I attached an internal SOW outline (BLH_SOW_v3.pdf) with the proposed milestones. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Marissa / Jonas —

Forwarding BLH request. They want a pilot-specific downsell schedule and an opt-out tied to milestones. The math: deal is $240k ARR equivalent (12-month equivalent with pilot conversion expectation). If we allow a 40/25/0% downsell liability over 90 days, worst-case revenue at risk is ~ $96k in month 1 then less — materially higher than our standard 90% ramp/commit.

I’m recommending one of two options for exec approval:
1) Conditional downsell protection: allow 30% liability month1, 15% month2, 0% thereafter, only if BLH provides 3 objective milestones and a PO for remainder of annualized value to be triggered at month 61 (i.e., commit to convert after pilot unless they provide notice). Requires discount cap of 12% and no credit for usage overage.
2) Full protection w/ staged buyout: allow 40/25/0% but require an upfront non-refundable pilot activation fee equal to 10% of the annualized amount and require legal to sign the sunset clause in SOW.

Neither is in our standard T&Cs — seeking Jonas and Marissa to greenlight which path we show the customer.

Karthik
Deal Desk Lead, Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the write-up Karthik and for looping me in. I’ve reviewed the options and here’s what I’ll approve for BlueLine Health given the strategic fit (healthcare reference, potential enterprise expansion):

Approved approach (conditional, exec sign-off):
- Adopt Option 2 (staged buyout) with the following refinements:
  - Downsizing liability schedule: 35% in month 1, 20% in month 2, 0% after month 3.
  - Add an upfront non-refundable pilot activation fee of 8% of the annualized contract value (ACV) instead of 10%.
  - Require three objective milestones (integration complete, first 100 sessions, clinical evaluation sign-off) to be documented in the SOW; opt-out must be submitted in writing within the 90-day window and will only be honored if milestone evidence is incomplete.
  - Cap total promotional discount across deal at 12% of ACV.
  - Legal should include specific sunset clause language: a defined buyout calculation (liability% * remaining ACV) and a clause that allows Redwood to invoice any unpaid portion within 30 days.

Conditions:
- Approval contingent on legal redline and final SOW being sent to BlueLine by EOD Friday (11/13).
- This exception is specific to BLH pilot and does not set precedent; include header: "Pilot Exception — Executive Approved (Jonas Weber)" in the SOW.

Marissa: please share the redline to Maya and Samir and make sure procurement confirms PO timeline. Karthik: work with legal to incorporate the exact buyout math in the redline-license-jonas.docx.

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

- Buyout math and invoice terms to be captured in the SOW redline (we will send a DocuSign link after you confirm these points).
